issuer: the Tennessee Department of Safety and Homeland Security, Driver Services
note: Driver Services' fee page (read 2026-10-30): the Class D operator licence is $3.25 a year for 8 years, $26, plus a $2 application fee, $28 in all (the total is held; county clerks add $4, not held); licences are renewed every eight years; the graduated table gives graduating to Class D at age 18, so a full licence is held from 18. ID only, 18 and over, is $1.25 a year for 8 years plus $2, $12 (under 18, $5 for 2 years); no age is held for the card. The Tennessee Code (on Lexis) wasn't reached, and Driver Services' Class D page refused the request (403).

sources.title: Tennessee Driver Services, Driver License Fees
sources.said: Tennessee licenses are renewed every eight (8) years from date of issuance instead of birthdate. ... D-Operator $3.25/year 8 Years $26.00 $2.00 $28.00 ... ID Only (18 and over) $1.25/year 8 Years $10.00 $2.00 $12.00 ... D-Graduating to Class D (Age 18)
